proposal.summary: CM550's low speed governor is a PID idle governor that cm550_runLowSpeedGovernor runs every 20 ms. Without a TSC1 override its reference (LSRF) is the desired speed LSDSRFRP. LSDSRFRP is the base speed LSBPRFES plus the operator's switch idle adjustment, and the cold idle speed can raise it. Under a TSC1 override the reference is the minimum idle speed LSMNRF. A throttle deadband offset gives the adjusted reference LSAJRFES. The filtered speed error LSER drives a proportional term, a filtered derivative term, a 16.16 integrator and two engine-speed (gain 2) terms. Their sum LSFL is clamped between limits taken from the 100 percent throttle 4D fueling at LSAJRFES plus the e2m 1064 offsets, and in FUELING_STATE_LOW_SPEED_GOVERNOR it replaces adjusted_user_fueling. The gains come from six three-word gain sets (default, aggressive, middle gear, high gear, J1939 and override) chosen by the gain logic. The TSC1 and override selectors are exact twins of CM848's. The gain set load, the aggressive gain logic and the gear gain logic are counterparts, because CM848's sets have four words (a jerk gain) and its aggressive logic uses engine acceleration and run timer conditions. The rows take CM848's names for the same e2m records, matched by mnemonic, because CM848 moved several LSG records to blocks 1496 / 14EE / 14EF / 14F0 and reordered 1064 / 1065. The RAM dump confirms the three-word gain set: the gain set pointer and the requested pointer both hold 0x808230, and the working gains 530 / 283 / 55 equal the three words of the aggressive set.

functions.role: Runs the whole low speed governor every 20 ms: the reference, the filtered speed error, the gain set load, the integrator preset or reset, the PID and engine speed terms, and the clamped fueling output.
functions.discriminator: It is the only writer of low_speed_governor_fueling_working (LSFL 0x80dade) and of the PID / speed terms (LSPPFL, LSDVFL, LSITFL, LSPP02FL, LSDV02FL), and the only function that copies the LSG output into adjusted_user_fueling (0x25fc2).
functions.plate_comment: The low speed governor (LSG), every 20 ms (cm550_runEvery4FramesTaskSetPhase2). Without a TSC1 override low_speed_governor_reference_speed (LSRF) = low_speed_governor_desired_reference_speed (LSDSRFRP) and low_speed_governor_adjusted_reference_speed (LSAJRFES) adds the filtered throttle deadband offset (low_speed_governor_throttle_deadband_gain x throttle) up to low_speed_governor_reference_speed_upper_limit; under a TSC1 override both are low_speed_governor_minimum_idle_speed (LSMNRF). While adjusted_user_fueling_state is FUELING_STATE_LOW_SPEED_GOVERNOR, or low_speed_governor_running_flag is set and engine speed is at most LSAJRFES + low_speed_governor_reference_offset, it filters the speed error (LSER), loads the gain set (cm550_loadLowSpeedGovernorGainSet), presets the integrator on entry and sums the proportional, derivative, integral and engine speed (gain 2) terms (plus no_load_fuel_quantity with low_speed_governor_no_load_fuel_enable) into low_speed_governor_fueling_working between low_speed_governor_fueling_clamp_minimum and low_speed_governor_fueling_clamp_maximum, which becomes adjusted_user_fueling in the LSG state; above low_speed_governor_reference_speed + low_speed_governor_reset_speed_offset at fueling below low_speed_governor_reset_fueling the integrator is reset to low_speed_governor_integrator_reset_value instead. Otherwise the running flag is cleared and the output follows the clamp maximum. Counterpart of CM848 cm848_runLowSpeedGovernor (which has jerk, gain adjustment and alternator load terms and no engine speed gain 2 terms).
functions.evidence: jsr 0x25b1c at 0x1b5d4 (cm550_runEvery4FramesTaskSetPhase2, second call). Reference: 0x25b38 LSDEGN 0x80825a mulu.w throttle 0x80aa82 through cm550_exponentialMovingAverage(0x801a62); 0x25b56 tst.w tsc1_override_control_mode; 0x25b5e LSRF = 0x808342 (LSMNRF) and LSAJRFES = it; 0x25b70 LSRF = 0x80db06 (LSDSRFRP), LSAJRFES = LSRF + offset, cmp.w 0x808256 / bls clamp at 0x25b84. Run condition 0x25b92-0x25bba: FSGVFLST 0x80a8f2 == 11, or LSEXFL 0x80daf6 and engine_rpm_primary <= LSAJRFES + LSRFOF 0x807a54. Error 0x25bbe-0x25c7a (LSAJRFES -= LSDPOFES 0x808264; LSFTGN 0x808240 x error >> 9; filter or preset 0x801a5a; clamp LSFTMX / LSFTMN). jsr 0x2629e at 0x25c9e; bsr 0x25a34 at 0x25cb8; reset 0x25cbc-0x25cfc. Terms 0x25d00-0x25e2c; bsr 0x2595a at 0x25e32; clamps 0x25e36-0x25e80; integrator 0x25e86-0x25f36; sum 0x25f42-0x25fb2; 0x25fc2 copy to adjusted_user_fueling; 0x25fd6 inactive branch. CM848 0x27ff8 has the jerk / alternator / gain adjustment terms: same role, different code.

functions.role: Presets the LSG integrator and output to the current final fueling when the LSG fueling state is entered.
functions.discriminator: It is the only writer of low_speed_governor_integrator_preset_maximum (LSMXITPZ 0x80daec), and the only code that sets the integral accumulator from final_fueling (0x25aea). It also zeroes the derivative term.
functions.plate_comment: Integrator preset of the low speed governor, called by cm550_runLowSpeedGovernor when adjusted_user_fueling_state is FUELING_STATE_LOW_SPEED_GOVERNOR and final_fueling_state is not yet. It refreshes low_speed_governor_reference_maximum_fuel_quantity (cm550_calculateLowSpeedGovernorReferenceMaximumFuelQuantity) and sets low_speed_governor_integrator_preset_maximum (e2m 1065 +E LSMXITPZ) = it + low_speed_governor_integrator_preset_maximum_offset (1064 +4 LSMXPZOF), limited to 0..0x1700. low_speed_governor_integral_accumulator (16.16) = final_fueling - LSER x LSPPGN / 960 + engine_rpm_primary x LSPP02GN / 2226 (minus no_load_fuel_quantity with low_speed_governor_no_load_fuel_enable), limited to low_speed_governor_integrator_preset_minimum .. maximum; then low_speed_governor_fueling_working = final_fueling, low_speed_governor_derivative_term = 0 and the engine speed and both proportional gains are kept as the previous-pass values. Counterpart of CM848 cm848_presetLowSpeedGovernorIntegrator (no engine speed term there, an optional reuse of the previous integral and a park or neutral minimum).
functions.evidence: bsr.w 0x25a34 at 0x25cb8 (runLSG, only caller). 0x25a50 bsr 0x2595a; 0x25a54-0x25a76 LSMXPZOF 0x80823a + 0x801a6e clamped 0..0x1700 into (a2)=0x80daec; 0x25a78-0x25aae final_fueling 0x80d32e - LSER x LSPPGN / 0x3c0 + speed x LSPP02GN / 0x8b2; 0x25ab0 andi.w #0x200 of 0x803cd4 then - NLFL 0x80db1c; clamp to (a3)=0x80823c / (a2); 0x25aea move.l to 0x801a6a; 0x25af0 LSFL = final_fueling; 0x25afa clr.w 0x80dae4; 0x25b00-0x25b10 previous speed / gains.

functions.role: Initializes the low speed governor at start-up: the two filter coefficient pointers, the gain selection and the fueling clamp maximum.
functions.discriminator: It is the only writer of the coefficient pointers of low_speed_governor_throttle_reference_offset_filter_state (0x801a62) and of low_speed_governor_error_filter (0x801a5a), and the only start-up seed of the fueling clamp maximum (0x1700).
functions.plate_comment: Start-up initializer of the low speed governor (mc68k_applicationMain). It points low_speed_governor_throttle_reference_offset_filter_state.coefficient at low_speed_governor_throttle_reference_offset_filter_coefficient (e2m 1064 +22 LSDEFTTC) and low_speed_governor_error_filter.coefficient at low_speed_governor_error_filter_coefficient (1064 +8 LSFTTC). It then runs cm550_initializeLowSpeedGovernorGainSelection and sets low_speed_governor_fueling_clamp_maximum (1065 +A LSMXLMFL) to 0x1700. Counterpart of CM848 cm848_initializeLowSpeedGovernorParameters, which also seeds three gain adjustments and an alternator load filter.
functions.evidence: jsr 0x26078 at 0x2880a (mc68k_applicationMain). 0x26078 move.l #0x808258,(0x801a62); 0x26082 move.l #0x80823e,(0x801a5a); 0x2608c jsr 0x26308; 0x26092 move.w #0x1700,(0x80dae8). CM848 0x28618: gain selection init, three adjustments 0x80, clamp 0x1700, alternator filter coefficient.

functions.role: Computes the cold idle speed (LSCIRF) every 100 ms and raises the LSG desired reference speed to it.
functions.discriminator: It is the only writer of LSCIRF (0x80db04) and of low_speed_governor_cold_idle_timer (0x801a84), and the only function that raises low_speed_governor_desired_reference_speed after it is computed.
functions.plate_comment: Cold idle speed of the low speed governor, every 100 ms (cm550_runEvery20FramesTaskSetPhase4, after cm550_updateLowSpeedGovernorIdleAdjustmentWrapper). Cold means the filtered coolant temperature is below low_speed_governor_cold_idle_coolant_temperature (e2m 1066 +0 LSCICLTP). With the engine stopped low_speed_governor_cold_idle_timer is cleared and LSCIRF (1067 +2, 0x80db04) = low_speed_governor_cold_idle_speed (1066 +2 LSCIRFSR) when cold, else 0. After cranking the timer counts while cold up to low_speed_governor_cold_idle_time (1066 +4 LSCITMLM). While running, once the time is up or the engine is warm, LSCIRF ramps down by low_speed_governor_cold_idle_ramp_rate (1066 +6 LSCIRMRT) to 0. low_speed_governor_desired_reference_speed (1049 +4 LSDSRFRP) is raised to LSCIRF unless low_speed_governor_cold_idle_override_enable and low_speed_governor_cold_idle_override_flag (1049 +6 LSCIOD) are both set. Counterpart of CM848 cm848_calculateLowSpeedGovernorCoolantTemperatureSpeed (a coolant table with hot idle and park or neutral logic).
functions.evidence: jsr 0x26616 at 0x1b7a8 (task set phase 4, after jsr 0x266d2 at 0x1b7a2). 0x26632 cmp coolant 0x80a336 with 0x80833a (bcc); 0x26646 andi.w #0x4000 of 0x803cac and tst 0x80db08; 0x26664 engine_state 0x80d0c8 == 1: clr (a3)=0x801a84, (a2)=0x80db04 = 0x80833c or 0; == 2 skip; timer to 0x80833e; == 3 ramp by 0x808340 (bls / sub.w); 0x266c0-0x266ca raise (a0)=0x80db06.

functions.role: Looks up the 100 percent throttle 4D fueling at the LSG adjusted reference speed (steady state and transient tables blended by the 4D interpolation factor) into low_speed_governor_reference_maximum_fuel_quantity.
functions.discriminator: It is the only writer of low_speed_governor_reference_maximum_fuel_quantity (0x801a6e). It looks up both 4D fueling tables at x = LSAJRFES and throttle 400 (100 percent). It contains no PID: its callers add the e2m 1064 offsets to the result.
functions.plate_comment: low_speed_governor_reference_maximum_fuel_quantity: the 100 percent throttle fueling at low_speed_governor_adjusted_reference_speed from the 4D fueling tables. With four_dimensional_fueling_interpolation_factor non-zero it looks up the steady state table (four_dimensional_fueling_steady_state_lookup, x = LSAJRFES, y = 400); below 0x4000 it looks up the transient table (four_dimensional_fueling_transient_lookup); each result passes through cm550_subtractAndClampValue. A factor of 0x4000 takes the steady state value and 0 the transient one; otherwise the result is transient + factor x (steady - transient) >> 14, limited to 0..0x1700. Called by cm550_presetLowSpeedGovernorIntegrator and cm550_runLowSpeedGovernor before they add the e2m 1064 offsets. Counterpart of CM848 cm848_calculateLowSpeedGovernorReferenceMaximumFuelQuantity, which has the same steps but no 0..0x1700 limit on the blend and a signed multiply (was cm550_governorFuelPidController).
functions.evidence: bsr.w from 0x25a50 (preset) and 0x25e32 (runLSG). 0x25978 tst.w (a2)=0x80d340; 0x2597c move.w 0x80daee -> 0x80d378 (x_input), 0x25986 move.w #0x190 -> 0x80d380 (y_input = 400), jsr 0x35088 (pea 0x80d372), jsr 0x1e02a; 0x259aa cmpi.w #0x4000 / bcc then the same on 0x80d388; 0x259d2-0x259e4 select; 0x259e6-0x25a28 mulu.l blend >> 14 + transient, clamped 0..0x1700 (0x25a10-0x25a26), move.w to (a4)=0x801a6e. CM848 0x27d38: same lookups (li r6,400; x = lhz 0x40aee0) and select, blend mullw / srawi 14 / addze, no clamp (0x27e0c-0x27e34).

functions.role: Runs the aggressive gain logic, chooses the gain set (TSC1, override, the requested set or the default set) and loads its three words into the working LSG gains.
functions.discriminator: It is the only writer of the working gains low_speed_governor_proportional_gain / integral_gain / derivative_gain (0x80dac4 / c6 / c8, loaded through the pointer). It is also the only code that sets the final gain state from the user gain state. It has nothing to do with the engine position sensor.
functions.plate_comment: Low speed governor gain set selection and load, called by cm550_runLowSpeedGovernor each LSG pass. It first runs cm550_updateLowSpeedGovernorAggressiveGainLogic, then selectLowSpeedGovernorTsc1GainSet and selectLowSpeedGovernorOverrideGainSet. When neither selects a set, low_speed_governor_final_gain_state = low_speed_governor_user_gain_state, and low_speed_governor_gain_set_pointer = low_speed_governor_default_gain_set for state 0 or low_speed_governor_requested_gain_set_pointer otherwise. It then loads the set's three words into low_speed_governor_proportional_gain / integral_gain / derivative_gain (e2m 10ED +0 / +2 / +4). Counterpart of CM848 cm848_loadLowSpeedGovernorGainSet, which loads four words (with a jerk gain) and does not run the aggressive gain logic (was cm550_enginePositionSensorControlModeSelector).
functions.evidence: jsr 0x2629e at 0x25c9e (runLSG only). 0x262ae jsr 0x2609c; 0x262b4 jsr 0x265e6; 0x262be bsr.s 0x26272 with the word pushed; 0x262c6 move.w 0x80daca,(a4)=0x80dacc; 0x262ce move.l #0x808314,(a3)=0x80dada or 0x262d6 move.l (0x80dad6),(a3); 0x262de-0x262ec move.w (a2) / (2,a2) / (4,a2) -> 0x80dac4 / 0x80dac6 / 0x80dac8. RAM dump: 0x80dada = 0x808230 and 0x80dac4/c6/c8 = 530 / 283 / 55 = the words at 0x808230/32/34. CM848 0x28a14: same TSC1 -> override -> user / default order, four words.

functions.role: Runs the LSG aggressive gain logic: the settled counts, the set and release of the inhibit flag, and the switch of the user gain state to and from 1 (the aggressive set).
functions.discriminator: It is the only function that counts the idle error and stopped vehicle settled counts (0x801a7a / 0x801a7c), sets or releases low_speed_governor_aggressive_gain_inhibit_flag (0x80dac2), sets user gain state 1 and points the requested gain set at low_speed_governor_aggressive_gain_set (0x808230).
functions.plate_comment: The LSG aggressive gain logic (e2m 10EE / 10EF), the first step of cm550_loadLowSpeedGovernorGainSet. While the absolute low_speed_governor_filtered_speed_error is inside low_speed_governor_maximum_idle_speed_error it counts low_speed_governor_idle_error_settled_count and, below low_speed_governor_aggressive_gain_low_vehicle_speed, low_speed_governor_stopped_vehicle_settled_count, each up to low_speed_governor_gain_logic_transition_time. low_speed_governor_aggressive_gain_inhibit_flag (LSGNLGFG) is released when the stopped vehicle count completes. It is set again above low_speed_governor_aggressive_gain_high_vehicle_speed, or, when low_speed_governor_aggressive_gains_used_flag is set, when the engine speed passes speed offset 3 with switch 16 bit 2 clear or the vehicle moves with the idle count complete. While not inhibited and with low_speed_governor_aggressive_gain_set_enable, low_speed_governor_user_gain_state goes to 1 (aggressive) past speed offset 2, or past offset 1 when the engine speed falls more than low_speed_governor_engine_speed_delta_threshold in one pass, and it returns to 0 with the hysteresis or a fast rise. State 1 sets the used flag and points low_speed_governor_requested_gain_set_pointer at low_speed_governor_aggressive_gain_set. Counterpart of CM848 cm848_updateLowSpeedGovernorAggressiveGainLogic, which uses engine acceleration, a run timer and a coolant condition (was cm550_enginePositionSensorAccelerationMonitor).
functions.evidence: jsr 0x2609c at 0x262ae (only caller). 0x260b8-0x260d2 |LSER| vs 0x808222; 0x260d4-0x26110 counts 0x801a7a / (a0)=0x801a7c vs 0x80821e, road speed 0x80a9d0 vs 0x808226; 0x26110-0x26166 inhibit set (0x801a76 == 1, LSER + 0x80822c, 0x80bccf & 4, 0x808226 / 0x801a7a, 0x808224); 0x2616c-0x26178 release (clr (a1)=0x80dac2, clr 0x801a76); 0x26184-0x26228 user state (a3)=0x80daca with andi.w #0x1000 of 0x803c96, 0x80822a / 0x808228 / 0x808220 / 0x801a78 / 0x80822e; 0x2622a-0x26238 0x801a76 = 1, 0x80dad6 = 0x808230; 0x26242 0x801a78 = engine_rpm_primary. CM848 0x28670 has the same inhibit structure but engine_acceleration_unfiltered, a run timer and coolant tests.

functions.role: Selects the J1939 (TSC1) gain set: gain state 4 while a TSC1 override control mode is active and the TSC1 gain set is enabled.
functions.discriminator: It is the only code that writes final gain state 4 and points the gain set pointer at j1939_low_speed_governor_gain_set (0x808334).
functions.plate_comment: With a TSC1 override control mode (tsc1_override_control_mode non-zero) and low_speed_governor_tsc1_gain_set_enable (algorithm_enable_flags_1_cal bit 0x8000) it sets low_speed_governor_final_gain_state = 4 and points low_speed_governor_gain_set_pointer at j1939_low_speed_governor_gain_set (e2m 10EB). It returns 1 when it selects the set, else 0. This is the first selection step of the gain set load. The twin of CM848 0x28b38 (one shared name) (was cm550_enginePositionSensorRpmTargetModeChecker).

Same position: the first call of the gain set load (CM550 jsr at 0x262b4, CM848 cm848_loadLowSpeedGovernorGainSet).

functions.role: Selects the override gain set from the fuel system specific algorithm when no TSC1 set is selected and the override gain state is non-zero.
functions.discriminator: It is the only code that copies low_speed_governor_override_gain_state into the final gain state and points the gain set pointer at low_speed_governor_override_gain_set (0x80dad0).
functions.plate_comment: It returns 1 at once when the TSC1 gain set is already selected (the argument). Otherwise, with low_speed_governor_override_gain_state (e2m 10ED +A LSOVGNST, set by the fuel system specific algorithm) non-zero, it copies that state to low_speed_governor_final_gain_state, points low_speed_governor_gain_set_pointer at low_speed_governor_override_gain_set (10ED +C) and returns 1; it returns 0 when the state is 0. This is the second selection step of the gain set load. The twin of CM848 0x289d0 (one shared name) (was cm550_enginePositionSensorOverrideChecker).

functions.role: Initializes the LSG gain selection at start-up: the aggressive gain logic reset, user gain state 0 and the override set copied from the default set.
functions.discriminator: It is the only writer of low_speed_governor_override_gain_set (a copy of the default set, 0x26324-0x26334) and the only start-up clear of the user gain state.
functions.plate_comment: Start-up part of cm550_initializeLowSpeedGovernor. It runs cm550_resetLowSpeedGovernorAggressiveGainLogic, sets low_speed_governor_user_gain_state to 0 and copies low_speed_governor_default_gain_set (e2m 10EC) into low_speed_governor_override_gain_set (10ED +C). Counterpart of CM848 cm848_initializeLowSpeedGovernorGainSelection, which copies four words and whose reset also sets the inhibit flag (was cm550_initializeEnginePositionSensorControlMode).

functions.role: Clears the aggressive gains used flag (0x801a76), as the first step of the gain selection initializer.
functions.discriminator: Its whole body is clr.w 0x801a76. It is the only clear of that flag outside the inhibit release in the aggressive gain logic.
functions.plate_comment: Clears low_speed_governor_aggressive_gains_used_flag (0x801a76) and nothing else. Its one caller is cm550_initializeLowSpeedGovernorGainSelection, which calls it first. Counterpart of CM848 cm848_resetLowSpeedGovernorAggressiveGainLogic, which also sets the inhibit flag and clears a run timer (was cm550_enginePositionSensorControlModeReset).

functions.role: Runs the LSG gear gain logic: requests the middle or high gear gain set from the overall gear ratio while the aggressive gains are inhibited.
functions.discriminator: It is the only writer of user gain states 2 / 3 and of the middle and high gear set pointers (0x80832c / 0x808326), the only user of the gear gain transition timer 0x801a7e, and the only reader of rear_axle_ratio (0x80a9f8).
functions.plate_comment: The LSG gear gain logic (e2m 10EA). It runs every 20 ms right after cm550_runLowSpeedGovernor (cm550_runEvery4FramesTaskSetPhase2), in FUELING_STATE_LOW_SPEED_GOVERNOR with low_speed_governor_aggressive_gain_inhibit_flag set. Outside the speed error window (low_speed_governor_gear_gain_speed_error_maximum / minimum) or out of gear (GROGSS 0x80a9d4), the user gain state and low_speed_governor_gear_gain_transition_timer go to 0. Inside it the timer counts to low_speed_governor_gear_gain_transition_time, and an overall ratio (gear ratio 0x80a9d2 x rear_axle_ratio >> 11) above low_speed_governor_gear_breakpoint_1 selects state 0. From state 0, after the transition time and with the middle gear enable, a ratio below breakpoint 1 minus low_speed_governor_gear_hysteresis requests low_speed_governor_middle_gear_gain_set (state 2), or with the high gear enable and below breakpoint 2 minus the hysteresis low_speed_governor_high_gear_gain_set (state 3), through low_speed_governor_requested_gain_set_pointer. Counterpart of CM848 cm848_selectLowSpeedGovernorGearGainSet, which has no out of gear test, clears the state outside the LSG and keeps a gain adjustment inhibit flag (was cm550_enginePositionSensorDiagnosticModeHandler).
functions.evidence: jsr 0x26340 at 0x1b5da (phase 2, right after runLSG). 0x2635c cmpi.w #0xb 0x80a8f2; 0x26368 cmpi.w #1 0x80dac2; 0x26374-0x26396 LSER vs 0x80831e / 0x808320 and tst.w 0x80a9d4; 0x26398 clr (a2)=0x80daca, clr (a0)=0x801a7e; 0x263a0 timer vs 0x808322; 0x263ac mulu.w 0x80a9d2 x 0x80a9f8 lsr 11; 0x263c2 vs 0x80831a; 0x263e0 andi 0x4000 / 0x26408 andi 0x2000 of 0x803c96; 0x26420 state 2 + move.l #0x80832c,(0x80dad6); 0x2644a state 3 + move.l #0x808326,(0x80dad6). CM848 0x4256c: same window, timer, ratio and breakpoints.

functions.role: Presets the LSG filtered speed error and its filter, resets the gain logic and stores the previous engine speed.
functions.discriminator: It is the only code outside cm550_runLowSpeedGovernor that writes LSER and presets low_speed_governor_error_filter's accumulator, and the only caller of cm550_resetLowSpeedGovernorGainLogic.

functions.role: Steps the operator idle speed adjustment with the idle increment / decrement switches, between the trim limits, and computes the LSG desired reference speed and the saved adjustment.
functions.discriminator: It is the only run-time writer of low_speed_governor_operator_idle_adjustment (0x801a82) from the switch edges, of low_speed_governor_desired_reference_speed = base + adjustment (0x26540) and of the saved adjustment LSICBKRF (0x805f0a), and the only user of the switch previous-state bytes 0x801a80 / 0x801a81.
functions.plate_comment: Operator idle speed adjustment of the low speed governor, every 100 ms through cm550_updateLowSpeedGovernorIdleAdjustmentWrapper. It works when idle_speed_adjust_enable (algorithm_enable_flags_3_cal LSISAJEN) is set and no fault is active (system error status word 7 bit 0x2 with its fault processing enable). A rising edge of the idle increment switch (switch 16 bit 0x20) then adds low_speed_governor_idle_adjustment_step (e2m 1072 +0 LSICDTIS) to low_speed_governor_operator_idle_adjustment, up to low_speed_governor_maximum_idle_speed_trim_cal - low_speed_governor_base_reference_speed_cal; a rising edge of the decrement switch (bit 0x40) subtracts it, down to the minimum trim minus the base. Without the enable, or with the fault, the adjustment is 0. Then low_speed_governor_desired_reference_speed (1049 +4 LSDSRFRP) = base + adjustment, low_speed_governor_saved_operator_idle_adjustment (1073 +0 LSICBKRF) = the adjustment with idle_speed_save_enable (else 0), and the switch states are kept for the next edge. No CM848 counterpart: CM848 has no reader of idle_speed_adjust_enable (was cm550_engineModeTimingAdjuster).

functions.role: The unsigned first-order filter on an ema_filter_state_t; here it filters the LSG throttle deadband offset.
functions.discriminator: A generic helper: cm550_runLowSpeedGovernor uses it for the throttle reference offset (0x25b4c). Its name and round 88 plate already describe it.
functions.plate_comment: The unsigned first-order filter (exponential moving average) on an ema_filter_state_t: accumulator = coefficient x accumulator / 65536 + sample x (65536 - coefficient); it returns the rounded integer part. No table or axis: it is the signed filter without the offset-binary step. By role it pairs with CM848's cm848_exponentialMovingAverage (0x56594) - the twin calculateAlphaFuelRateResult calls it in both firmwares - but the formulation differs (a truncated +- |difference| step), so it is a counterpart (was cm550_coreTableInterpolation; PR #53 round 88)

functions.role: The signed first-order filter on an ema_filter_state_t; here it filters the LSG speed error.

functions.plate_comment: The signed first-order filter on an ema_filter_state_t: the sample is offset binary (+ 0x8000); accumulator = coefficient x accumulator / 65536 + (sample + 0x8000) x (65536 - coefficient); it returns the rounded integer part - 0x8000. By role it pairs with CM848's cm848_signedFirstOrderFilter (0x5644c), a different formulation (a truncated +- |difference| step), so it is a counterpart, not a twin (was exponentialMovingAverage, a name it shared with CM848's UNSIGNED filter 0x56594; PR #53 round 88)

Then LSRF = LSDSRFRP and LSAJRFES = LSRF + offset, limited to LSRFESUL; or both = LSMNRF while tsc1_override_control_mode (JCEGMD) is nonzero. A run: subtract the droop offset LSDPOFES (0x808264); LSER = LSFTGN x (LSAJRFES - rpm) >> 9 (preset on the first pass, then filtered), clamped to LSFTMN / LSFTMX with the accumulator preset; load the gain set (0x2629e); preset the integrator on entry into the LSG state; reset it above LSRF + LSITRSES at fueling below LSITRSFL. Otherwise build P (LSER x LSPPGN / 960), D (filtered, +-LSMXDVFL), the speed P2 / D2 terms, the clamps and the integrator (16.16, bumpless gain-change terms, LSMNITFL..LSMXITFL). LSFL = I + P - P2 + D - D2 (+ no_load_fuel_quantity with LSNLFLEN), clamped LSMNLMFL..LSMXLMFL, copied into adjusted_user_fueling in state 11; LSEXFL = 1. Not running: LSEXFL = 0, LSFL = LSMXLMFL. Last: previous rpm.
roles.discriminator: The only writer of LSFL, LSAJRFES, LSRF and the run-path integrator. The decompile matches the disassembly 0x25b1c-0x25ff0.
roles.cm848_counterpart: cm848_runLowSpeedGovernor @ 0x27ff8 (+ cm848_calculateLowSpeedGovernorErrorTerms @ 0x28ba4): counterpart. CM848 computes the error terms in another task and has gain adjustments, a jerk term, alternator load fuel and a reset delay timer. CM550 has the throttle deadband reference and the speed P2 / D2 terms.

roles.role: Integrator preset, called only by cm550_runLowSpeedGovernor (bsr at 0x25cb8) when adjusted_user_fueling_state = 11 and final_fueling_state is not. It refreshes the reference maximum fuel (bsr 0x2595a) and sets LSMXITPZ = it + LSMXPZOF, limited to 0..0x1700. The 16.16 integrator = final_fueling - LSER x LSPPGN / 960 + rpm x LSPP02GN / 2226 (- no_load_fuel_quantity with LSNLFLEN), limited to LSMNITPZ..LSMXITPZ (signed compares). Then LSFL = final_fueling, LSDVFL = 0, and the previous rpm / LSPPGN / LSPP02GN are stored.
roles.discriminator: The only writer of LSMXITPZ, and the only place that sets the integrator from final_fueling.
roles.cm848_counterpart: cm848_presetLowSpeedGovernorIntegrator @ 0x27e4c: counterpart. CM848 has no engine speed term, can reuse the previous integral term, and has a park / drive minimum.

roles.role: Reference maximum fuel of the LSG. While four_dimensional_fueling_interpolation_factor != 0: the steady state 4D table at (LSAJRFES, 400 = 100 % throttle) through cm550_tableLookup2D, then cm550_subtractAndClampValue. While the factor < 0x4000: the transient table the same way. Result: the steady value at 0x4000, the transient value at 0, else transient + factor x (steady - transient) >> 14 (unsigned mulu), clamped 0..0x1700. The result goes to low_speed_governor_reference_maximum_fuel_quantity (0x801a6e). Called by the LSG run (0x25e32) and the integrator preset (0x25a50). No PID is involved.
roles.discriminator: The only family function that does the 4D table lookups and the only writer of 0x801a6e.
roles.cm848_counterpart: cm848_calculateLowSpeedGovernorReferenceMaximumFuelQuantity @ 0x27d38: a near twin, with the same lookups, the same constants 400 / 0x4000 / >>14 and the same callers. Only CM550 clamps the blend to 0..0x1700, and it uses unsigned arithmetic where CM848 uses signed. Under the strict twin rule that makes it a counterpart, so it keeps the cm550_ prefix.

roles.role: Presets the LSG speed error. LSER = LSFTGN (0x808240) x ((LSAJRFES - rpm) - LSDPOFES) >> 9, clamped to LSFTMN / LSFTMX. The error filter accumulator = LSER << 16 + 0x80000000. It then runs 0x262fa (resets both gain logics' counters) and stores the previous rpm. The dumped ROM holds no jsr / bsr to it and no 4-byte pointer to it, so a caller would have to be in the undumped code above 0x40000.
roles.discriminator: Presets LSER without running the governor. It is the only caller of 0x262fa.
roles.cm848_counterpart: none found (CM848 computes the error terms every pass in cm848_calculateLowSpeedGovernorErrorTerms)

roles.role: Start-up initializer (jsr at 0x2880a in mc68k_applicationMain). It points the throttle reference offset filter at LSDEFTTC (0x808258) and the error filter at LSFTTC (0x80823e), runs the gain selection initializer 0x26308, and sets LSMXLMFL = 0x1700.

roles.cm848_counterpart: cm848_initializeLowSpeedGovernorParameters @ 0x28618: counterpart. It also runs the gain selection initializer and sets the clamp maximum to 0x1700, but it seeds the gain adjustments and the alternator filter, not CM550's two filters.

roles.role: Cold idle speed, every 100 ms (cm550_runEvery20FramesTaskSetPhase4). Cold = coolant below LSCICLTP. While the engine is STOPPED it clears the timer 0x801a84 and sets LSCIRF (0x80db04) = LSCIRFSR when cold, else 0. In any state other than CRANKING the timer counts up to LSCITMLM while cold. In RUNNING, once the time is up or the engine is warm, LSCIRF ramps down by LSCIRMRT (0x808340) to 0. LSDSRFRP is raised to LSCIRF unless low_speed_governor_cold_idle_override_enable and LSCIOD are both set.

roles.cm848_counterpart: cm848_calculateLowSpeedGovernorCoolantTemperatureSpeed @ 0x28d44: counterpart (CM848 uses a coolant table, a hot idle and a park / neutral design)

roles.role: Start-up (jsr at 0x287d4). With idle_speed_save_enable it restores the operator idle adjustment 0x801a82 from LSICBKRF (0x805f0a); otherwise it zeroes both. It clears LSCIOD (0x80db08). It raises the trim LSMNRFTN (0x803fca) to at least LSMNRF (0x808342) and lowers LSMXRFTN (0x803fcc) to at most LSMXRF (0x808344).

roles.role: Operator idle speed adjustment, every 100 ms (through the wrapper 0x266d2 in cm550_runEvery20FramesTaskSetPhase4). It clears 0x801a82 when idle_speed_adjust_enable is off or fault bit 7 / 0x2 is active. On a rising edge of switch 16 bit 0x20 it adds the step 0x808332, up to LSMXRFTN - LSBPRFES. On a rising edge of bit 0x40 it subtracts the step, down to LSMNRFTN - LSBPRFES. Then LSDSRFRP (0x80db06) = 0x801a82 + LSBPRFES, and LSICBKRF (0x805f0a) = 0x801a82 when idle_speed_save_enable is set, else 0. No timing is involved.

roles.role: The LSG gain set loader, called by the LSG run at 0x25c9e. It runs the aggressive gain logic 0x2609c, then the TSC1 selector 0x265e6, and passes that result to the override selector 0x26272. When neither selector applies: LSFNGNST = LSUSGNST, and the pointer 0x80dada = the default set 0x808314 (LSUSGNST 0) or the requested set pointer 0x80dad6. It then loads the three working gains from the pointer: LSPPGN 0x80dac4 = (a2), LSITGN 0x80dac6 = (2,a2), LSDVGN 0x80dac8 = (4,a2).
roles.discriminator: The only function that copies the working P / I / D gains from the gain set pointer. It is the only caller of the aggressive logic and of the TSC1 and override selectors.
roles.cm848_counterpart: cm848_loadLowSpeedGovernorGainSet @ 0x28a14: counterpart. CM848 does not run the aggressive logic here (it is its own task) and loads 4 words, the 4th being the jerk gain.

roles.role: TSC1 gain set selector. If tsc1_override_control_mode (0x80da50, e2m 10E8 +4 JCEGMD) is 0, or algorithm_enable_flags_1_cal bit 0x8000 (LSJCGNEN) is clear, it returns 0. Otherwise LSFNGNST = 4, the gain set pointer 0x80dada = 0x808334 (the J1939 gain set, e2m 10EB +0), and it returns 1.

The steps are the same in the same order: the same JCEGMD record, the same 0x8000 bit, final gain state 4, the pointer to the 10EB set, return 1 / 0. Both are called by the gain loader, which passes the result to the override selector. Both rows take the shared unprefixed name.

roles.role: Override gain set selector. If the argument (the TSC1 result) is nonzero it returns 1. If LSOVGNST (0x80dace, 10ED +A) is 0 it returns 0. Otherwise LSFNGNST = LSOVGNST, the pointer 0x80dada = 0x80dad0 (the override set, 10ED +C), and it returns 1.
roles.discriminator: Selects the override set and copies LSOVGNST into LSFNGNST.
roles.cm848_counterpart: cm848_selectLowSpeedGovernorOverrideGainSet @ 0x289d0: twin (the same steps and the same records, the second call of the gain loader). Both rows take the shared unprefixed name.

roles.role: Aggressive gain logic, run by the gain loader every LSG pass. If |LSER| > LSMXERES, both settled counts (0x801a7a, 0x801a7c) are cleared. Otherwise 0x801a7a counts up to LSLGTZTM, and 0x801a7c counts up to LSLGTZTM while road speed 0x80a9d0 < LSLOVS (cleared at or above it). Not inhibited (LSGNLGFG 0x80dac2 = 0): LSGNLGFG is set when road speed > LSHIVS, or when the latch 0x801a76 = 1 and either (LSER + LSOF03ES < 0 with switch 0x80bccf bit 4 clear) or (road speed >= LSLOVS with the error count complete). Inhibited: once the stopped-vehicle count is complete it clears LSGNLGFG and 0x801a76. Not inhibited: LSUSGNST 0 -> 1 (with LSAGGNEN bit 0x1000) when LSER > LSOF02ES, or when LSER > LSOF01ES and rpm + LSDCTDES < previous rpm. LSUSGNST 1 -> 0 on LSER < LSOF01ES - LSHYES, or on LSER < LSOF02ES with the speed rising. Inhibited, it forces LSUSGNST 1 to 0. While LSUSGNST = 1: 0x801a76 = 1 and the requested pointer 0x80dad6 = 0x808230 (aggressive set). Previous rpm 0x801a78 = rpm. Nothing about acceleration monitoring or EPS.
roles.discriminator: The only writer of LSUSGNST = 1, LSGNLGFG and the aggressive set pointer.
roles.cm848_counterpart: cm848_updateLowSpeedGovernorAggressiveGainLogic @ 0x28670: counterpart. The inhibit and switching structure is the same, but CM848 adds a minimum run time, a coolant and a tool-state condition, uses engine acceleration where CM550 uses rpm minus the previous rpm, has a separate active flag, and runs as its own task.

roles.role: Gear gain logic, every 20 ms (call 3 of cm550_runEvery4FramesTaskSetPhase2, right after the LSG). Only in LSG state with LSGNLGFG = 1. If LSER is outside 0x808320..0x80831e or GROGSS (0x80a9d4, out of gear) is set: LSUSGNST = 0 and the timer 0x801a7e = 0. Otherwise the timer counts up to 0x808322, and ratio = gear ratio 0x80a9d2 x VSRRAXRA 0x80a9f8 >> 11. Above the middle breakpoint 0x80831a: LSUSGNST = 0. With the timer complete and the middle enable bit 0x4000 set, below the breakpoint - LSHYGR: state 2 (requested pointer = middle set 0x80832c), or state 3 (high set 0x808326) with bit 0x2000 below the high breakpoint 0x80831c - LSHYGR. Nothing diagnostic.
roles.discriminator: The only writer of LSUSGNST 2 / 3 and of the gear set pointers.

roles.role: Gain selection initializer, from cm550_initializeLowSpeedGovernor (jsr at 0x2608c). It runs 0x2626a, clears LSUSGNST, and copies the 3-word default set 0x808314/16/18 into the override set 0x80dad0/2/4.

roles.role: Clears 0x801a76, the aggressive gains latch that 0x2609c sets while LSUSGNST = 1 and reads in its inhibit decision. Called only by 0x26308.
roles.discriminator: Touches only the aggressive latch.

roles.role: Sets the aggressive logic's previous engine speed 0x801a78 = engine_rpm_primary and clears its two settled counts 0x801a7a / 0x801a7c. These are now misnamed as cooldown timers. Called only by 0x262fa. No rpm tracking for EPS.

roles.role: Clears the gear gain transition timer 0x801a7e and sets the axle ratio in use VSRRAXRA (0x80a9f8, 117D +34) from VSRRAXRL (0x803d40, 1180 +6). Its only other user is the gear gain logic (0x263b4). Called only by 0x262fa. No oil pressure is involved.

Start-up sets LSRF = this (0x28936). The torque curve update 0xfb26 tests this against LSRF +- LSRFESDC, the same test as CM848. Read-only, 8 word reads. Type word.

roles.role: e2m 1073 +0 LSICBKRF 'RPM ADDED TO LSG REFERENCE' (signed, 0.125 rpm, -300..300; dump 600 = 75 rpm). 0x26474 stores the operator idle adjustment 0x801a82 here while idle_speed_save_enable (LSISSVEN 'save of last idle speed at shutdown') is set, else 0. At start-up 0x2658c restores 0x801a82 from it. RAM outside the EEPROM image, so no _cal. Type i16.

roles.role: e2m 104B +E APLSTMTR 'TIME THAT MUST EXPIRE WITHOUT LSG COMMANDING FUEL BEFORE ALPHA' (0.02 s; dump 15000). The reload value of the alpha LSG timer 0x80a910: calculateAlphaLowSpeedGovernorResult (0xc4da) reloads it while final_fueling_state = 11 or the detected flag is set, and calculateAlpha (0xc35c) reloads it at stop / crank / jump start. Read-only. Type word.
roles.discriminator: The timeout constant, not the running timer.

roles.role: e2m 11A3 +0 LSRFOF02 'OFFSET TO LOW IDLE REFERENCE SPEED USED IN LSG-TO-NO ADJUST TRANSITION' (0.125 rpm, unsigned; dump 800 = 100 rpm). No code in the dumped ROM reads or writes it: only the parameter-ID table entry at 0x360b4, and no base+displacement access was found. Its neighbour FUHY (11A3 +2) and the 1046 transition counts have no reader either, so the fueling state arbitration is probably in the undumped code. Type word (from the record).

roles.discriminator: The half width of the base-speed band around LSRF.

roles.role: e2m 1064 +2 LSMNLMFL 'LSG FUELING CLAMP MIN' (dump 0). The lower clamp of LSFL (unsigned cmp.l, 0x25f8a). Type word.

roles.discriminator: The fueling half of the reset condition.

verdicts.own_role: Every 20 ms (phase 2 task set): LSRF = LSDSRFRP (LSMNRF under TSC1), LSAJRFES = LSRF + filtered throttle deadband offset capped by 0x808256; runs in fueling state 11 or with LSEXFL while rpm <= LSAJRFES + LSRFOF; filters LSER, loads the gain set, presets the integrator on entry, resets it above LSRF + LSITRSES at low fueling, else LSFL = P + D + I - P2 - D2 (+NLFL) clamped and copied to adjusted_user_fueling in state 11; not running: LSEXFL = 0, LSFL = clamp max.
verdicts.reason: Investigator and describer agree. My disassembly of 0x25b1c-0x25ff0 confirms every step, and the only caller is jsr 0x1b5d4. Name kept. Plate amended: the two gain 2 terms are subtracted (sub.l 0x25f52 / 0x25f66), not summed; the cap now has its corrected name; the integrator also subtracts FSAPITAJ 0x80d350; the dropped history note is restored.
verdicts.final_comment: The low speed governor (LSG), every 20 ms (cm550_runEvery4FramesTaskSetPhase2). Without a TSC1 override low_speed_governor_reference_speed (LSRF) = low_speed_governor_desired_reference_speed (LSDSRFRP) and low_speed_governor_adjusted_reference_speed (LSAJRFES) = LSRF + the throttle deadband offset (low_speed_governor_throttle_deadband_gain x the validated commanded throttle, filtered by cm550_exponentialMovingAverage), capped at low_speed_governor_adjusted_reference_speed_maximum; under a TSC1 override both are low_speed_governor_minimum_idle_speed (LSMNRF). While adjusted_user_fueling_state is FUELING_STATE_LOW_SPEED_GOVERNOR, or low_speed_governor_running_flag is set and engine speed is at most LSAJRFES + low_speed_governor_reference_offset, it takes low_speed_governor_droop_offset_speed off LSAJRFES, filters the speed error (LSER; preset on the first pass), loads the gain set (cm550_loadLowSpeedGovernorGainSet) and presets the integrator on entry into the LSG fueling state. With engine speed above low_speed_governor_reference_speed + low_speed_governor_reset_speed_offset and adjusted_user_fueling below low_speed_governor_reset_fueling it resets the integrator to low_speed_governor_integrator_reset_value and zeroes LSER instead. Otherwise low_speed_governor_fueling_working = the proportional, derivative and integral terms minus the two engine speed (gain 2) terms (plus no_load_fuel_quantity with low_speed_governor_no_load_fuel_enable), between low_speed_governor_fueling_clamp_minimum and low_speed_governor_fueling_clamp_maximum, and in the LSG state it becomes adjusted_user_fueling; the integrator update also subtracts the FSAPITAJ word 0x80d350 (e2m 10D3 +0) each pass. When the LSG does not run the running flag is cleared and the output follows the clamp maximum. Counterpart of CM848 cm848_runLowSpeedGovernor (which has jerk, gain adjustment and alternator load terms and no engine speed gain 2 terms) (was vp44_fuel_timing_calculation_with_fault_checking; PR #53 round 89)

verdicts.own_role: On entry into the LSG fueling state: refreshes the reference maximum fuel, LSMXITPZ = it + LSMXPZOF (0..0x1700), integrator = final_fueling - LSER x LSPPGN / 960 + rpm x LSPP02GN / 2226 (- NLFL) clamped LSMNITPZ..LSMXITPZ, LSFL = final_fueling, LSDVFL = 0, previous speed / gains stored.
verdicts.reason: Both agree. Disassembly 0x25a34-0x25b1a matches, and the only caller is bsr 0x25cb8. The plate is correct. It is amended only to keep '(was vp44_FUN_00025a34; PR #53 round 96)', which the new plate dropped.
verdicts.final_comment: Integrator preset of the low speed governor, called by cm550_runLowSpeedGovernor when adjusted_user_fueling_state is FUELING_STATE_LOW_SPEED_GOVERNOR and final_fueling_state is not yet. It refreshes low_speed_governor_reference_maximum_fuel_quantity (cm550_calculateLowSpeedGovernorReferenceMaximumFuelQuantity) and sets low_speed_governor_integrator_preset_maximum (e2m 1065 +E LSMXITPZ) = it + low_speed_governor_integrator_preset_maximum_offset (1064 +4 LSMXPZOF), limited to 0..0x1700. low_speed_governor_integral_accumulator (16.16) = final_fueling - LSER x LSPPGN / 960 + engine_rpm_primary x LSPP02GN / 2226 (minus no_load_fuel_quantity with low_speed_governor_no_load_fuel_enable), limited to low_speed_governor_integrator_preset_minimum .. maximum; then low_speed_governor_fueling_working = final_fueling, low_speed_governor_derivative_term = 0 and the engine speed and both proportional gains are kept as the previous-pass values. Counterpart of CM848 cm848_presetLowSpeedGovernorIntegrator (no engine speed term there, an optional reuse of the previous integral and a park or neutral minimum) (was vp44_FUN_00025a34; PR #53 round 96)

It points low_speed_governor_throttle_reference_offset_filter_state.coefficient at low_speed_governor_throttle_reference_offset_filter_coefficient (e2m 1064 +22 LSDEFTTC) and low_speed_governor_error_filter.coefficient at low_speed_governor_error_filter_coefficient (1064 +8 LSFTTC). It then runs cm550_initializeLowSpeedGovernorGainSelection and sets low_speed_governor_fueling_clamp_maximum (1065 +A LSMXLMFL) to 0x1700. verdicts.own_role: Every 100 ms: cold = coolant below LSCICLTP; STOPPED clears the timer and sets LSCIRF = LSCIRFSR or 0; CRANKING skips; else the timer counts while cold; RUNNING ramps LSCIRF down by LSCIRMRT once the time is up or warm; LSDSRFRP is raised to LSCIRF unless the override bit and LSCIOD are set.
verdicts.reason: Both agree and the disassembly 0x26616-0x266d0 matches, with the only caller jsr 0x1b7a8. The plate is correct. Amended only to keep '(was cm550_FUN_00026616; PR #53 round 96)'.
verdicts.final_comment: Cold idle speed of the low speed governor, every 100 ms (cm550_runEvery20FramesTaskSetPhase4, after cm550_updateLowSpeedGovernorIdleAdjustmentWrapper). Cold means the filtered coolant temperature is below low_speed_governor_cold_idle_coolant_temperature (e2m 1066 +0 LSCICLTP). With the engine stopped low_speed_governor_cold_idle_timer is cleared and LSCIRF (1067 +2, 0x80db04) = low_speed_governor_cold_idle_speed (1066 +2 LSCIRFSR) when cold, else 0. After cranking the timer counts while cold up to low_speed_governor_cold_idle_time (1066 +4 LSCITMLM). While running, once the time is up or the engine is warm, LSCIRF ramps down by low_speed_governor_cold_idle_ramp_rate (1066 +6 LSCIRMRT) to 0. low_speed_governor_desired_reference_speed (1049 +4 LSDSRFRP) is raised to LSCIRF unless low_speed_governor_cold_idle_override_enable and low_speed_governor_cold_idle_override_flag (1049 +6 LSCIOD) are both set. Counterpart of CM848 cm848_calculateLowSpeedGovernorCoolantTemperatureSpeed (a coolant table with hot idle and park or neutral logic) (was cm550_FUN_00026616; PR #53 round 96)

CM848 0x27d38 has the same steps but uses mullw / srawi / addze with no clamp, a signed factor test and separate-argument lookups, so it is a counterpart, not a twin. The old 'PID controller' name was wrong. The new name is free.

verdicts.own_role: Runs the aggressive gain logic, then the TSC1 and override selectors; if neither selects, final state = user state and pointer = default set (state 0) or the requested pointer; then copies the set's three words into 0x80dac4/c6/c8.
verdicts.reason: Both agree. It is the only writer of the working gains (0x262de-0x262ec) and its only caller is jsr 0x25c9e. The RAM dump confirms it: pointer 0x808230 and gains 530/283/55. CM848 0x28a14 loads four words and does not run the aggressive logic, so it is a counterpart. The current eps name is wrong.

verdicts.own_role: Settled counts 0x801a7a / 0x801a7c, release / set of the inhibit LSGNLGFG (high speed; or, once used, clutch-off overspeed past offset 3 or moving with the idle count complete), user state 0 <-> 1 by offsets 1 / 2, hysteresis and pass-to-pass speed change, latch 0x801a76 and requested pointer 0x808230 in state 1, previous rpm store.
verdicts.reason: Both agree on the role and my disassembly 0x2609c-0x26250 confirms it; the only caller is jsr 0x262ae. Name confirmed. Plate amended: the 0x80bccf bit 2 is the clutch switch (e2m 000E +1 DSCHSWSS, the same test as CM848's clutch_switch), not 'switch 16'. The plate now also says that the release clears the used flag, that state 1 is forced to 0 while inhibited and that the previous speed is stored.
verdicts.final_comment: The LSG aggressive gain logic (e2m 10EE / 10EF), the first step of cm550_loadLowSpeedGovernorGainSet. While the absolute low_speed_governor_filtered_speed_error is inside low_speed_governor_maximum_idle_speed_error it counts low_speed_governor_idle_error_settled_count and, below low_speed_governor_aggressive_gain_low_vehicle_speed (cleared at or above it), low_speed_governor_stopped_vehicle_settled_count, each up to low_speed_governor_gain_logic_transition_time; outside the error band both are cleared. While low_speed_governor_aggressive_gain_inhibit_flag (LSGNLGFG) is set, a complete stopped vehicle count releases it and clears low_speed_governor_aggressive_gains_used_flag.
